recipes.name: Quatro Quesos Dos Fritos inspired by Psych
instructions: Place the potatoes on a baking sheet, covering them in olive oil and poking them with plenty of holes. - 3 russet potatoes - Olive oil
Preheat the oven to 350°F and roast the potatoes until cooked through.
Cut the potatoes in half while they are still piping hot and allow the steam to escape for 15 to 20 minutes.
While they are still warm, run them through a potato ricer on its finest setting.
Chop and add the butter so that it melts in the still warm potato. - 3 tbsp chopped butter
Add a whole egg to the butter and potato. - Eggs
Season liberally with kosher salt and freshly ground pepper. - Salt - Pepper
Add flour to the mixture if it is too soft to handle. - Flour
Mix thoroughly and cover with plastic wrap that is right down on the surface of the potatoes.
Chill for at least 30 minutes or until firmed up.
Cube some sharp cheddar cheese. - Sharp cheddar
Wrap the cheese in the potato mixture. Next, coat the potato ball in flour, then dip it in an egg wash, and lastly dip it in bread crumbs. - Flour - Eggs - Panko bread crumbs
Heat a quart of vegetable oil to 350°F.
Fry those guys for 5 to 7 minutes or until browned and crisp.
Season generously with kosher salt. - Salt
Combine some dried ancho chili powder with sour cream. - Sour Cream - Dried Ancho Chili powder
Roast bacon in a 375°F Oven for 20 to 25 minutes until nice and crisp. - Crispy bacon
Put some of the sour cream mixture on a plate, sprinkle with bacon bits and finally the cheese filled potatoes on top.
